case.summary: Case HHG-019 involves an online card-not-present transaction initiated from a new Windows and Chrome device that was first seen at the time of the transaction. Although the card history shows prior confirmed fraud cases both on this card tuple and on a different card belonging to the customer, the transaction occurred on a low-risk device family with a small shared degree and no prior confirmed-fraud cases on the device itself. Furthermore, Vesta’s new device flag and the bank's model decile scoring both weigh more heavily toward cleared alerts such as travel or a new phone rather than confirmed fraud. Weighing these factors together, the calibrated probability of fraud is low at 0.06, leading to a legitimate verdict. Consequently, the policy engine has determined that the transaction should be closed with no fraud detected, resulting in action CLOSE_NO_FRAUD.
